cases.sentence: Я ревностно служил Господу, Богу ___ Израиля.
cases.translation: I have been very jealous for the Lord, the God of Israel.
cases.explain: The phrase "Бог сил" uses the genitive case for the possession.

cases.sentence: Он вошел в ___ и заночевал в ней.
cases.translation: He went into the cave and spent the night there.
cases.explain: The preposition "в" with location (where one stays) uses the prepositional case.

cases.sentence: Он пошел в ___, на расстояние в день пути.
cases.translation: He went into the wilderness, a day's journey away.
cases.explain: The preposition "в" with motion (where one is going to) uses the accusative case.

cases.sentence: Вот у его ___ лепешка и кувшин воды.
cases.translation: There at his head was a cake and a jar of water.
cases.explain: The preposition "у" (at, near) always governs the genitive case.

cases.translation: According to the word of the Lord which he spoke.
cases.explain: The preposition "по" (according to) can govern the dative case.

cases.translation: Stand on the mountain before God.
cases.explain: The preposition "перед" (before) governs the instrumental case.

cases.sentence: Израилетяне отвергли завет, разрушили ___, убили пророков.
cases.translation: The Israelites rejected the covenant, destroyed the altars, killed the prophets.
cases.explain: The transitive verb "разрушили" (destroyed) governs the accusative case.

cases.sentence: Между Арамом и Израилем не было ___ три года.
cases.translation: For three years there was no war between Syria and Israel.
cases.explain: In negative existential constructions, the genitive case is used with "не было".

reading.ru: Ахав рассказал Изавели обо всем, что сделал Илия, и о том, как он перебил всех пророков Баала мечом.
reading.question: What did Ahab tell Jezebel about Elijah?
options: That Elijah killed all the prophets of Baal with the sword
That Elijah destroyed the altar of Baal
That Elijah performed a great miracle
reading.correct: That Elijah killed all the prophets of Baal with the sword
reading.explain: The text states that Ahab told Jezebel all that Elijah had done, including how he struck down all the prophets of Baal with the sword.

reading.ru: Добравшись до Версавии, что в Иудее, он оставил там слугу, а сам ушел в пустыню.
reading.question: What did Elijah do when he reached Beersheba?
options: He left his servant there and went alone into the wilderness
He stayed with his servant and rested
He went to worship at the temple
He gathered followers for his journey
reading.correct: He left his servant there and went alone into the wilderness
reading.explain: The text states that when Elijah reached Beersheba in Judah, he left his servant there and went alone into the wilderness.

reading.ru: Затем он лег под роковым кустом и уснул.
reading.question: What happened to Elijah under the tree?
options: He lay down and fell asleep
He ate bread and drank water
He received a vision from God
reading.correct: He lay down and fell asleep
reading.explain: The text states that Elijah lay down under the juniper tree and fell asleep.

reading.ru: Подкрепившись той пищей, он шел сорок дней и сорок ночей, пока не достиг Харива, Божьей горы.
reading.question: How long did Elijah travel after eating?
reading.explain: The text explicitly states that strengthened by the food, he journeyed forty days and forty nights.

reading.ru: Я ревностно служил Господу, Богу сил. Израилетяне отвергли завет с тобой, разрушили твои жертвенники.
reading.question: What complaint did Elijah make?
options: The Israelites rejected the covenant and destroyed the altars
The kings of Israel were unjust
No one believed in God anymore
reading.correct: The Israelites rejected the covenant and destroyed the altars
reading.explain: Elijah told God that the Israelites had forsaken the covenant and torn down the altars.

reading.ru: После ветра было землетрясение, но в землетрясении Господа не было. После землетрясения прошел огонь, но в огне Господа не было.
reading.question: What did Elijah experience on the mountain?
options: Wind, earthquake, and fire, but God was not in any of them
A great vision of God in the whirlwind
An angel appearing with a message
A loud voice calling from heaven
reading.correct: Wind, earthquake, and fire, but God was not in any of them
reading.explain: The text describes how Elijah experienced wind, earthquake, and fire, but God was not in the wind, earthquake, or fire.
